## Score Regression Model CombiGel

This section builds a machine learning model to score IsoFrac–UniProt assignments.

Enrichment-derived features (e.g. p-values, peptide overlap, sequence counts) are used to train models (Random Forest, GBM, Deep Learning) that distinguish true matches from randomized controls.

The resulting score (score_ref) provides a unified confidence measure for each isoform assignment and is used for filtering, ranking, and downstream Figure 3 analyses.

```{r Random Forest CombiGel}
# Initialize the result container if this is the first run
if(!exists("plotCollecter")){
  plotCollecter <- list()
}

# Start H2O for machine-learning scoring
library(h2o)
h2o.init()

# Recompute only when needed
if(length(Results_CombinedGels$VarImp)==0|rerun){
  print("Calculating Regression Scores")
  cl <- makeCluster(20)

  # Clean and enrich each similarity result set before modeling
  ENSG_Similarity <- parLapply(cl,ENSG_Similarity,function(y){
  y <- y
  # x <- y$rev
  library(data.table)

  # Extract useful numeric fields from the IsoFrac and UniProt labels,
  # then derive DeltaMass between both candidates
  Prepare_EnrichmentTable <- function(x){
    x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac_MW <- gsub(".*.# ","",x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac)
    x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac_MW <- gsub(" .*.","",x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac_MW)
    x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac_MW <- as.numeric(x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac_MW)

    x$enrichmentTable$Uniprot_MW <- gsub(".*.# ","",x$enrichmentTable$Uniprot)
    x$enrichmentTable$Uniprot_MW <- gsub(" .*.","",x$enrichmentTable$Uniprot_MW)
    x$enrichmentTable$Uniprot_MW <- as.numeric(x$enrichmentTable$Uniprot_MW)
    x$enrichmentTable$DeltaMass <- x$enrichmentTable$Uniprot_MW-x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac_MW

    # Add network-level context: how many clusters and gels contributed to each IsoFrac entry
    IF <- x$IsofracInfo
    IF[,c("nClusters","nGels"):={
      cl <- strsplit(.BY$clusters,";")
      gel <- strsplit(.BY$gels,";")
      temp <- unique(cbind(unlist(cl),unlist(gel)))
      list(length(unique(temp[,1])),length(unique(temp[,2])))
    },.(clusters,gels,ENS)]

    # Join the enrichment table with the IsoFrac metadata
    x$enrichmentTable <- cbind(x$enrichmentTable,IF[match(x$enrichmentTable$IsoFrac,IF$LabelID),.SD,.SDcols=c("nClusters","nGels","gel","heights","Height","Height_lm","Fraction_sd_80")])

    x
  }

  # Prepare forward (real) enrichment results
  if(length(y$fw)>1){
    y$fw <-Prepare_EnrichmentTable(y$fw)
  }

  # Prepare randomized / reverse enrichment results
  if(length(y$rev)>1){

    try({
      # y$rev <-Prepare_EnrichmentTable(y$rev)
      y$rev$enrichmentTable <- NULL
      y$rev <- lapply(y$rev,function(x){Prepare_EnrichmentTable(x)})
      et <- lapply(y$rev,function(x){x$enrichmentTable})
      et <- rbindlist(et,fill=T)
      et$V1 <- NULL
      et <- et[!is.na(nClusters )]
      et$seed <- NULL
      y$rev$enrichmentTable <- unique(et)
    })

  }

  y

})

  stopCluster(cl)

  # Merge all forward and reverse results into a single modeling table
  it <- 5
  x <- ENSG_Similarity
  print(it)
  er <- try({
    print("Preparing fw table")
    ensg <- names(x)
    fw <- lapply(1:length(x),function(i){
      i <- i
      y <- x[[i]]
      if(length(y$fw)>1){
        hu <- y$fw$enrichmentTable;
        hu$ENSG <- ensg[[i]]
      }else{hu <- NULL}

      hu
    })
    fw <- rbindlist(fw[lengths(fw)>1],fill=T)
    print("Preparing rv table")

    rv <- lapply(1:length(x),function(i){
      y <<- x[[i]]
      if(length(y$rev)>1){

        hu <- y$rev$enrichmentTable;

        hu$ENSG <- ensg[[i]]
      }else{
        hu <- NULL
      }
      hu
    })
    rv <- rbindlist(rv,fill=T)
    rv$IsoFrac_MW <- gsub(".*.# ","",rv$IsoFrac)
    rv$IsoFrac_MW <- gsub(" .*.","",rv$IsoFrac_MW)
    rv$IsoFrac_MW <- as.numeric(rv$IsoFrac_MW)

    rv$Uniprot_MW <- gsub(".*.# ","",rv$Uniprot)
    rv$Uniprot_MW <- gsub(" .*.","",rv$Uniprot_MW)
    rv$Uniprot_MW <- as.numeric(rv$Uniprot_MW)
    rv$DeltaMass <- 1

    # Label forward and reverse examples for supervised learning
    fw$type <- "fw"
    rv$type <- "rv"

    # Check that the columns align as expected
    setdiff(names(rv),names(fw))
    setdiff(names(fw),names(rv))

    # Combined table for downstream scoring
    hu <- rbind(fw,rv,fill=T)
    names(rv) <- paste("rv",names(rv),sep="_")
    tabiAllGelscbind <- cbind(fw,rv)
    hu$gel_MainPeak <- hu$gel
    hu$gel <- it
    tabiAllGels <- hu

    tabiAllGels[,{apply(.SD,2,function(x){length(unique(x))})},type]
    unique(tabiAllGels[ENSG=="ENSG00000120802"&type=="fw"]$IsoFrac)
  })

  # Final feature engineering for the model
  tabiAllGels$DeltaMass <- tabiAllGels$IsoFrac_MW-as.numeric(tabiAllGels$Uniprot_MW)
  tabiAllGels$QuotientMass <- tabiAllGels$IsoFrac_MW/as.numeric(tabiAllGels$Uniprot_MW)
  names(tabiAllGels) <- make.unique(names(tabiAllGels))
  setnames(tabiAllGels,old = "dhpyer_p_UP","dhyper_p_UP",skip_absent = T)

  # Track whether UniProt assignment is single- or multi-candidate
  tabiAllGels$MultiMapping <- c("One candidate","More candidates (Median)")[as.numeric( grepl(";",tabiAllGels$Uniprot))+1]
  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered <- tabiAllGels

  names(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered)
  names(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered_iprs)

  # Compare the two hypergeometric scores
  tabiAllGels$SamePvalue <- tabiAllGels$dhyper_p==tabiAllGels$dhyper_p_IF
  ggplot(tabiAllGels,aes(-log10(dhyper_p),-log10(dhyper_p_IF),color=type))+geom_bin2d(bins=500)+facet_grid("SamePvalue")

  # Base feature table for H2O
  FeatureTable <- tabiAllGels[,.SD,.SDcols=c("dhyper_p","IsofracOverlap","UniprotOverlap","all_sequences","type","IsoFrac_MW","AbsoluteSequenceLength")]
  tabiAllGels$IsoFrac_MW_round <- round(tabiAllGels$IsoFrac_MW,-3)
  tabiAllGels$Uniprot_MW_round <- round(tabiAllGels$Uniprot_MW,-3)

  # Alternative feature versions used in earlier testing
  FeatureTableOri <- tabiAllGels[,.SD,.SDcols=c("dhyper_p","IsofracOverlap","UniprotOverlap","all_sequences","type","IsoFrac_MW_round","AbsoluteSequenceLength")]
  FeatureTableOri2 <- tabiAllGels[,.SD,.SDcols=c("dhyper_p","IsofracOverlap","UniprotOverlap","all_sequences","type","IsoFrac_MW","AbsoluteSequenceLength")]

  # Final model input: compact feature set
  FeatureTable <- tabiAllGels[,.SD,.SDcols=c("dhyper_p","IsofracOverlap","UniprotOverlap","all_sequences","type","IsoFrac_MW_round","AbsoluteSequenceLength")]
  FeatureTable <- tabiAllGels[,.SD,.SDcols=c("dhyper_p","IsofracOverlap","UniprotOverlap","type")]

  # Additional derived feature: fraction of all peptides that are Uniprot-supported
  FeatureTable$TotalUniprotFraction <- as.numeric(tabiAllGels$All_Uniprot_Peptides)/as.numeric(tabiAllGels$all_sequences)

  # Convert class labels to numeric target for H2O
  FeatureTable$type <- factor(FeatureTable$type,c("fw","rv"),c(1,0))
  FeatureTable$type <- as.numeric(as.character(FeatureTable$type))

  # Ensure all columns are numeric before conversion to H2O
  FeatureTable <- apply(FeatureTable,2,as.numeric)
  FeatureTable <- data.table(FeatureTable)

  # Quick sanity check: feature variability by class
  FeatureTable[,{
    apply(.SD,2,function(x){length(unique(x))})
  },type]

  # Convert to H2O frame
  h2o.FeatureTable <- as.h2o(FeatureTable)

  # Train three model families for comparison
  md_rf<- h2o.randomForest(training_frame = h2o.FeatureTable,y="type",nfolds = 10,seed=1234)
  md_gbm <- h2o.gbm(training_frame = h2o.FeatureTable,y="type",nfolds = 10,seed=1234)
  md_dl <- h2o.deeplearning(training_frame = h2o.FeatureTable,y="type",nfolds = 10,seed=1234)

  # Remove old model artifacts before saving new ones
  unlink("CombinedGels_UniProtAssignmentModel",recursive = T)
  unlink("CombinedGels_UniProtAssignmentModelgbm",recursive = T)
  unlink("CombinedGels_UniProtAssignmentModeldl",recursive = T)

  # Save trained models
  h2o.save_mojo(md_rf,"CombinedGels_UniProtAssignmentModel")
  h2o.save_mojo(md_gbm,"CombinedGels_UniProtAssignmentModelgbm")
  h2o.save_mojo(md_dl,"CombinedGels_UniProtAssignmentModeldl")

  # Score the training table with each model
  score_rf <- as.data.frame(predict(md_rf,h2o.FeatureTable))
  score_rf_gbm <- as.data.frame(predict(md_gbm,h2o.FeatureTable))
  score_rf_dl <- as.data.frame(predict(md_dl,h2o.FeatureTable))

  # Store predicted scores back into the master table
  tabiAllGels$score_ref_gbm <- as.data.frame(score_rf_gbm$predict)
  tabiAllGels$score_ref_rf <- as.data.frame(score_rf$predict)
  tabiAllGels$score_ref_dl <- as.data.frame(score_rf_dl$predict)
  tabiAllGels$score_ref <- as.data.frame(score_rf_gbm$predict)

  # Compare model outputs and score behavior
  ggplot(tabiAllGels,aes(score_ref_dl,score_ref_gbm))+geom_bin_2d()
  ggplot(tabiAllGels,aes(dhyper_p,dhyper_p_IF))+geom_bin_2d()
  tabiAllGels[ENSG=="ENSG00000007866"&type=="fw"]

  # Model interpretation
  h2o.varimp_plot(md_rf)
  h2o.varimp_plot(md_gbm)
  h2o.varimp_plot(md_dl)

  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered <- tabiAllGels
  Results_CombinedGels$VarImp <- h2o.varimp(md_rf)
  Results_CombinedGels$FeatureTable <- FeatureTable

  print("Finished Scoring")
}else{
  print("Loading RandomForest AllGelRESULTS")
}
names(tabiAllGels) <- make.names(names(tabiAllGels))

```

## ROC allGels before filtering

This section evaluates how well the assignment features separate forward from reverse matches before any filtering. It computes ROC curves and AUC values for each feature, then uses those results as a baseline check for the scoring model on the combined gels.

```{r ROC allGels before filtering}

# Load combined (unfiltered) IsoFrac–Uniprot pairs
tabiAllGels <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered 

require(ggplot2)

# Loop over selected gels (here: combined dataset encoded as gel == 5)
gel_rocs <- lapply(c(5), function(geli){

  gelname <- "AllGels"
  
  # Subset data for selected gel
  sel <- tabiAllGels$gel == geli
  
  # Select relevant features for ROC analysis
  FeatureSelect <- tabiAllGels[sel, .SD,
    .SDcols = c("dhyper_p","IsofracOverlap","UniprotOverlap","type","score_ref_gbm")
  ]
  
  # Rename features for readability in plots
  setnames(FeatureSelect,
           c("dhyper_p","IsofracOverlap","UniprotOverlap","score_ref_gbm"),
           c("Overlap","Coverage Isofrac","Coverage Uniprot","ML Score"))
  
  # Define class labels: TRUE = forward (correct), FALSE = reverse (decoy)
  typevec <- FeatureSelect$type
  FeatureSelect$type <- NULL
  typevec <- typevec == "fw"
  
  it <<- 0
  
  # Compute ROC for each feature
  rocs <- apply(FeatureSelect, 2, function(x){
    
    it <<- it + 1
    
    # ROC curve for full dataset
    pos <- pROC::roc(typevec, as.numeric(x))
    
    # Bootstrap AUC estimates (robustness)
    aucs <- sapply(1:10, function(i){
      p <- as.double(NA)
      
      # resample with replacement
      sa <- sample(1:length(x), length(x), replace = TRUE)
      
      # ensure both classes are present
      if(length(unique(typevec[sa])) == 2){
        pos <- pROC::roc(typevec[sa], as.numeric(x[sa]))
        p <- pos$auc
      }
      p
    })
    
    list(
      q = quantile(aucs, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),  
      pos = pos,                                                     
      feature = colnames(FeatureSelect)[it]
    )
  })
  
  # Prepare ROC curve data for plotting
  rocs_d <- rbindlist(lapply(rocs, function(x){
    data.table(
      Specificity = x$pos$specificities,
      Sensitivity = x$pos$sensitivities,
      feature = paste(x$feature, round(x$pos$auc, 2))
    )
  }))
  
  # Order features for consistent plotting
  rocs_d$feature <- factor(rocs_d$feature, c(
    grep("Isofrac", rocs_d$feature, value = TRUE)[1],
    grep("Uniprot", rocs_d$feature, value = TRUE)[1],
    grep("Overlap", rocs_d$feature, value = TRUE)[1],
    grep("Score", rocs_d$feature, value = TRUE)[1]
  ))
  
  # ROC curve plot
  g_rocs <- ggplot(
    rocs_d[grep("all_sequences", feature, invert = TRUE)],
    aes((Specificity), (Sensitivity), color = feature)
  ) +
    geom_line() +
    xlim(c(1, 0)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 1, lty = "dotted")
  
  # AUC summary table
  rocstable <- rbindlist(lapply(rocs, function(x){as.list(x$q)}))
  rocstable$Feature <- names(rocs)
  
  # Order by median AUC
  rocstable <- rocstable[order(`50%`)]
  rocstable$namefac <- factor(rocstable$Feature,
                             rocstable$Feature[order(rocstable$`50%`)])
  
  # AUC barplot with confidence intervals
  g_roc_bar <- ggplot(rocstable, aes(namefac, `50%`)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = `5%`, ymax = `95%`)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
    ylab("AUC") +
    xlab("") +
    ggtitle(gelname) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 1))
  
  # Return both plots
  list(bar = g_roc_bar, rocs = g_rocs)

})

# Store results
Results_CombinedGels$gel_rocs <- lapply(gel_rocs, function(x){x$rocs})
Results_CombinedGels$gel_auc  <- lapply(gel_rocs, function(x){x$bar})

# Save for plotting later
plotCollecter$ROC_Curves_combined <- Results_CombinedGels$gel_rocs

```


## Filtering of Table

This section filters the combined IsoFrac assignment table by keeping the highest-confidence match per gel, gene, and isoform. It compares the GBM-based assignment with the smallest delta-mass candidate, annotates each result with gene-symbol metadata and confidence classes, and then stores the final filtered table for downstream figure generation and manuscript statistics.

```{r, filtering of TabiTable all Gels}

# Start from the unfiltered combined result table
tabiAllGels <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered

# Quick sanity check for one example gene/isoform
unique(tabiAllGels[ENSG == "ENSG00000120802" & type == "fw"]$IsoFrac_MW_round)

# Run this block only once unless rerun = TRUE
if (length(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered) == 0 | rerun) {
  print("Filtering Table")

  # Assign a row ID for downstream tracking
  tabiAllGels$id <- 1:dim(tabiAllGels)[1]

  # Use GBM score as the primary assignment score
  useGBM <- T
  if (useGBM) {
    tabiAllGels$score_ref <- tabiAllGels$score_ref_gbm
  }

  # Select the best candidate per gene / isoform / gel / type group
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels <- tabiAllGels[, {
    cat("\r", .GRP)

    temp <- .SD
    temp$score_ref <- as.numeric(temp$score_ref)

    # Best assignment by model score
    tempResults <- temp[score_ref == max(score_ref)]

    # Best assignment by smallest absolute delta mass
    tempResults_DM <- temp[abs(DeltaMass) == min(abs(DeltaMass))]

    # Random reference candidates for comparison
    tempResults_random  <- temp[sample(1:dim(temp)[1], 1)]
    tempResults_random2 <- temp[sample(1:dim(temp)[1], 1)]
    tempResults_random3 <- temp[sample(1:dim(temp)[1], 1)]

    # Compare score-based vs delta-mass-based choice
    if (any(tempResults$Uniprot == unique(tempResults_DM$Uniprot))) {
      Category <- "Score_equals_DM"
    }
    if (all(tempResults$Uniprot != unique(tempResults_DM$Uniprot))) {
      Category <- "Score_unequals_DM"
    }

    # Normalize to data.table if only one row is returned
    if (is.vector(tempResults)) {
      tempResults <- as.data.table(as.list(tempResults))
    } else {
      tempResults <- as.data.table(tempResults)
    }

    if (is.vector(tempResults_DM)) {
      tempResults_DM <- as.data.table(as.list(tempResults_DM))
    } else {
      tempResults_DM <- as.data.table(tempResults_DM)
    }

    # Drop helper column before exporting
    tempResults$MultiMapping <- NULL
    tempResults_DM$MultiMapping <- NULL

    # Record number of candidate rows in each selection
    tempResults$ScoreFilteredEntries <- dim(tempResults)[1]
    tempResults_DM$ScoreFilteredEntries <- dim(tempResults_DM)[1]

    # Store comparison category
    tempResults$Category <- Category

    # Collapse delta-mass-selected candidate to one row of values
    tempResults_DM <- apply(tempResults_DM, 2, function(x) {
      paste(unique(x), collapse = ";")
    })
    tempResults_DM <- as.list(tempResults_DM)

    # Attach delta-mass-selected summary to the score-selected result
    tempResults$DMFiltered_DeltaMass      <- tempResults_DM$DeltaMass
    tempResults$DMFiltered_Uniprot        <- tempResults_DM$Uniprot
    tempResults$DMFiltered_UniprotOverlap  <- tempResults_DM$UniprotOverlap
    tempResults$DMFiltered_IsofracOverlap  <- tempResults_DM$IsofracOverlap

    # Attach random reference values for later plotting
    tempResults$Random_DeltaMass_1 <- tempResults_random$DeltaMass
    tempResults$Random_DeltaMass_2 <- tempResults_random2$DeltaMass
    tempResults$Random_DeltaMass_3 <- tempResults_random3$DeltaMass

    # Collapse to a single record
    tempResults <- apply(tempResults, 2, function(x) {
      paste(unique(x), collapse = ";")
    })
    as.list(tempResults)
  }, .(gel, type, ENSG, IsoFrac)]

  # Rename score-based fields for clarity
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ScFiltered_DeltaMass     <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$DeltaMass
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ScFiltered_Uniprot       <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$Uniprot
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ScFiltered_UniprotOverlap <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$UniprotOverlap
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ScFiltered_IsofracOverlap<- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$IsofracOverlap

  # Mark genes with ambiguous HGNC symbols as non-unique
  TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
    x <<- x
    x$dt_gn$hgnc_symbol <- gsub("^;", "", x$dt_gn$hgnc_symbol)
    x$dt_gn$Use <- T
    x$dt_gn$Use[grep(";", x$dt_gn$hgnc_symbol)] <- F
    x$dt_gn
    x
  })

  # Build one gene-symbol lookup table across all gels
  dt_gn <- rbindlist(lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) { x$dt_gn }))
  dt_gn$seq <- NULL
  dt_gn$gn <- NULL
  dt_gn$UniAccession <- NULL
  dt_gn$GN_ENS <- NULL
  dt_gn$ens_Count <- NULL
  dt_gn$ens_original <- NULL
  dt_gn <- unique(dt_gn)

  # Collapse duplicate ENS entries into one HGNC symbol string
  dt_gn_uni <- dt_gn[, {
    temp <- .SD
    gr <- .BY
    if (dim(temp)[1] > 1) {
      gn <- sapply(strsplit(temp$hgnc_symbol, ";"), function(x) {
        paste(sort(x), collapse = ";")
      })
      gn <- gsub("^;|;$", "", gn)
      gn <- unique(gn)
    } else {
      gn <- temp$hgnc_symbol
    }
    list(hgnc_symbol = gn, Use = all(Use))
  }, ens]

  # Attach HGNC symbols and gene usability flags
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$hgnc_symbol <- dt_gn_uni$hgnc_symbol[match(FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ENSG, dt_gn_uni$ens)]
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$Use         <- dt_gn_uni$Use[match(FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ENSG, dt_gn_uni$ens)]

  # Add the same gene metadata to the unfiltered table
  Unfiltered <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered
  Unfiltered$hgnc_symbol <- dt_gn_uni$hgnc_symbol[match(Unfiltered$ENSG, dt_gn_uni$ens)]
  Unfiltered$Use         <- dt_gn_uni$Use[match(Unfiltered$ENSG, dt_gn_uni$ens)]

  # Classify each assignment by GBM confidence
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$IdentificationStatus <- "Undefined"
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[score_ref_gbm >= 0.75]$IdentificationStatus <- "Good"
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[score_ref_gbm > 0.5 & score_ref_gbm < 0.75]$IdentificationStatus <- "Mediocre"
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[score_ref_gbm < 0.5]$IdentificationStatus <- "Unsufficient"

  # Compute the smallest delta mass for each assignment group
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[, c("ScFiltered_DM_min") := {
    temp <- .BY
    UniFun <- as.numeric(unique(unlist(strsplit(temp$Uniprot_MW, ";"))))
    Iso    <- as.numeric(temp$IsoFrac_MW)
    Diffis <- Iso - UniFun
    Quoties <- log10(Iso / UniFun)

    MinMass <- Diffis[abs(Diffis) == min(abs(Diffis), na.rm = T)]
    .(min_DM = MinMass)
  }, .(Uniprot_MW, Uniprot, IsoFrac, IsoFrac_MW, score_ref, type)]

  # Alias for easier downstream plotting
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$DM_min <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ScFiltered_DM_min

  # Quick diagnostic plot: score versus minimum delta mass
  ggplot(
    FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[type == "fw"],
    aes(ScFiltered_DM_min, as.numeric(score_ref_gbm), color = paste(Category, IdentificationStatus))
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    xlab("minimal Delta Mass (IsoFrac-Uniprot)") +
    ylab("Sequence Score")

  # Final label assignment:
  # - keep score-based assignment when supported
  # - fall back to delta-mass-based assignment when score confidence is low
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$IdentificationStrategy <- "SequenceBased"

  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgelsNewFile <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[, {
    label <- "Undefined"
    gr <- .BY
    temp <- .SD
    gr$DM_min <- as.numeric(gr$DM_min)
    gr$DMFiltered_DeltaMass <- as.numeric(gr$DMFiltered_DeltaMass)

    if (gr$ScFiltered_Uniprot == gr$DMFiltered_Uniprot) {
      label <- "Single Candidate"
    } else {
      if (abs(abs(gr$ScFiltered_DM_min) - abs(gr$DMFiltered_DeltaMass)) < 5000) {
        label <- "SequenceBased, >5kD<"
      } else {
        if (gr$score_ref > 0.5) {
          if (gr$ScFiltered_DM_min > 0) {
            label <- "SequenceBased, DM>5kD"
          }
          if (gr$ScFiltered_DM_min < 0) {
            label <- "SequenceBased, DM<5kD"
          }
        } else {
          label <- "DM_Based"
          temp$Uniprot    <- gr$DMFiltered_Uniprot
          temp$DeltaMass  <- gr$DMFiltered_DeltaMass
          temp$DM_min     <- gr$DMFiltered_DeltaMass
          temp$Uniprot_MW <- gsub(" Da", "", gsub(".*. # ", "", gr$DMFiltered_Uniprot))
        }
      }
    }

    temp$DeltaMass  <- as.numeric(temp$DeltaMass)
    temp$DM_min     <- as.numeric(temp$DM_min)
    temp$Uniprot_MW <- as.numeric(temp$Uniprot_MW)

    temp$label <- label
    temp
  }, .(ScFiltered_Uniprot, ScFiltered_DM_min, IdentificationStatus, Category,
       DMFiltered_Uniprot, DMFiltered_DeltaMass, score_ref, type)]

  # Inspect final label distribution
  table(FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgelsNewFile$label)

  # Save filtered result table
  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgelsNewFile

  # Quick inspection for known examples
  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[ENSG == "ENSG00000172216" & type == "fw"]
  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered[ENSG == "ENSG00000172216"]

  TMPO <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered[ENSG == "ENSG00000120802" & type == "fw"]
  TMPO <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[ENSG == "ENSG00000120802" & type == "fw"]

  unique(TMPO$IsoFrac_MW)

  # Persist the updated combined results
  save(Results_CombinedGels, file = "Results_CombinedGels.rda")

} else {
  print("Loading Results combined after Filtering")
}

# Timestamp check for the saved object
file.info("Results_CombinedGels.rda")$mtime

```

##  FDR estimate

This section estimates the false discovery rate (FDR) of IsoFrac–UniProt assignments based on the learned scoring model.

Forward (fw) and reverse (rv) matches are used to derive an empirical FDR curve by ranking assignments by score and calculating the proportion of reverse hits. A loess model is then fitted to smooth this relationship and assign an FDR value to each score.

Finally, only forward (fw) assignments are retained for downstream analysis, now annotated with an estimated FDR, enabling confidence-based filtering of protein isoform candidates.


```{r, FDR all Gel}
geli <- 5

# Keep only filtered pairs that passed the current selection step
FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[Use == TRUE]

# Use one gel as the reference for estimating the FDR curve
tempi <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[gel == 5]

# Extract score and type (fw / rv) for the selected gel
df_true <- tempi[, .SD, .SDcols = c("score_ref", "type")]
df_true <- df_true[order(as.numeric(score_ref), decreasing = TRUE)]

# Identify reverse hits, which are used as proxy false positives
FalseGrep <- grep("rv", df_true$type)

# Empirical FDR: cumulative reverse hits / rank
FDR <- (1:length(FalseGrep)) / FalseGrep

# Plot score vs empirical FDR
plot(
  counts <- as.numeric(df_true$score_ref[FalseGrep]),
  FDR,
  main = paste("gel", geli)
)
grid(lty = "dotted")
abline(h = c(0.1, 0.2), lty = "dotted")

# Smooth the empirical curve with a loess fit
o <- order(FDR, decreasing = TRUE)
lomo <- loess(
  c(FDR[o], rep(0, 100)) ~ c(counts[o], seq(1, 1.1, length.out = 100)),
  span = 0.2
)

# Overlay the fitted FDR curve
points(lomo$x, lomo$fitted, type = "l", col = 2, lwd = 2)

# Predict FDR for all filtered scores
scfun <- as.numeric(FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$score_ref)
FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$FDR <- predict(lomo, scfun)

# Keep only forward assignments for downstream analysis
FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[type == "fw"]

```

##  DeltaMassDistributions

This section compares delta-mass distributions for:
- the best-scoring IsoFrac-to-UniProt assignments,
- the raw DM-based assignments,
- and random background matches.

The goal is to see whether the score-based selection concentrates the mass differences differently from random or unfiltered candidates.

```{r ,DeltaMass distributions all Gels}

# Start from the filtered assignment table
temp <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[type == "fw"]

tempi_G <- tempi[, length(unique(DeltaMass)), .(IsoFrac_MW, ENS)]

temp_G$Type <- "Filtered"

temp_G_ALL <- rbind(tempi_G, temp_G)
temp_G_ALL[, Include := length(unique(Type)) == 2, .(IsoFrac_MW, ENS)]

# Make sure the delta-mass columns are numeric for plotting
temp$DMFiltered_DeltaMass <- as.numeric(temp$DMFiltered_DeltaMass)
temp$DM_min <- as.numeric(temp$DM_min)
temp$ScFiltered_DM_min <- as.numeric(temp$ScFiltered_DM_min)
temp$Random_DeltaMass_1 <- as.numeric(temp$Random_DeltaMass_1)
temp$Random_DeltaMass_2 <- as.numeric(temp$Random_DeltaMass_2)
temp$Random_DeltaMass_2 <- as.numeric(temp$Random_DeltaMass_3)

# Long-format table for density comparisons
temp_melt <- melt(
  temp[Use == T],
  measure.vars = c(

    "DM_min",

  )
)

# Spot check a known example
temp_melt[hgnc_symbol == "TEAD3"]

# Label and group the different delta-mass sources

temp_melt$group <- factor(
  temp_melt$group,
  c("Random_DeltaMass", "ScFiltered_DM_min", "DMFiltered_DeltaMass", "DM_min"),
  c("Random", "Best scoring", "smallest Delta Mass", "Score and DM filtered")
)

dim(temp_melt[group == "Best scoring"])
```

## PIe Char Categories

This section maps the selected IsoFrac assignments to UniProt categories, collapses multi-mapping protein annotations into a cleaner category label, and summarizes the category distribution as a pie chart. It also flags intronless genes for later comparison.

```{r,fig.cap="Fractions of most likely Uniprot categories explaining isofrac isoforms. SwissProt_PC (proteolytic cleavage) is most often linked to isofrac isoforms."}

## Pie Chart of UniProt Categories
# Color palette used for downstream category plots
cbPalette = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

# Keep only high-confidence, forward-direction assignments
FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[Use == TRUE & type == "fw"]

# Collapse duplicate sequence entries into a single row per sequence
ProteinSequences <- ProteinSequencesCategories[, {
  hu <- apply(.SD, 2, function(x) {
    paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse = ";")
  })
  li <- as.list(hu)
  names(li) <- names(.SD)
  li
}, SEQUENCE]

# Collect UniProt IDs, scores, and use flags from the filtered table
CombiVec <- c()
UP <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[type == "fw"]$Uniprot
Sc <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[type == "fw"]$score_ref
Use <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[type == "fw"]$Use == "TRUE"
UPsplit <- strsplit(UP, ";")

# Build a UniProt annotation table for each assignment
if (!exists("UP_L") | 1) {
  UP_L <- lapply(UP, function(UniprotID) {
    x <- unlist(strsplit(UniprotID, ";"))
    # Remove trailing score annotation from UniProt IDs
    x <- gsub(" # .*$", "", x)

    # Extract clean UniProt accession if the ID uses pipe-separated format
    xORI <- sapply(strsplit(x, "|", fixed = TRUE), function(x) {
      if (length(x) > 1) {
        x <- x[2]
      } else {
        x
      }
      x
    })
    xORI <- gsub("_.*.", "", xORI)

    # Try matching against the curated database first
    xtempInit <- ProteinSequencesCategories[match(x, ProteinID)]
    xtemp <- xtempInit[Canonical_in_gff == FALSE, ]

    # Fall back to original accession matching if needed
    if (dim(xtemp)[1] == 0) {
      xtempInit <- ProteinSequencesCategories[match(xORI, ProteinID)]
      xtemp <- xtempInit[Canonical_in_gff == FALSE, ]
    }

    # Collapse multimapping rows into one annotation record
    if (dim(xtemp)[1] > 1) {
      xtemp <- apply(xtemp, 2, function(y) {
        y <- gsub("^ ", "", y)
        if (all(!is.na(as.logical(y)))) {
          y <- any(as.logical(y))
        } else {
          y <- paste(unique(y), collapse = ";")
        }
        y
      })

      xtemp <- data.table(xtemp)
      xtemp <- t(xtemp)
      xtemp <- as.data.table(xtemp)
      colnames(xtemp) <- colnames(ProteinSequencesCategories)

      # Detect whether the merged row still represents one or multiple variants
      cleanedstring <- gsub("_.*.", "", lelu <- strsplit(xtemp$ID, ";")[[1]])
      cleanedstring <- gsub("-.*.", "", cleanedstring)

      if (length(unique(cleanedstring)) == 1) {
        xtemp$Multimapper <- F
        xtemp$Variants <- length(cleanedstring)
      } else {
        xtemp$Multimapper <- T
        xtemp$Variants <- length(lelu)
      }

      if (dim(xtemp)[1] > 1) {
        xtemp <<- xtemp
        stop("WEOIFOEWF")
      }
    } else {
      # Single mapping: keep as-is
      xtemp <- xtemp
      xtemp$Multimapper <- F
      xtemp$Variants <- 1
    }

    xtemp$UniprotID <- UniprotID
    xtemp
  })
}

# Handle cases where the UniProt mapping produced no row
DIMS <- sapply(UP_L, function(x) { dim(x)[1] })

if (any(DIMS == 0)) {
  UP_L[which(DIMS == 0)] <- lapply(UPsplit[DIMS == 0], function(x) {
    huha <- ProteinSequences[grep(x[1], ProteinSequences$ProteinID, value = FALSE), ]
    huha$Multimapper <- ""
    huha$Variants <- ""
    huha$UniprotID <- paste(x, collapse = ";")
    print(dim(huha))
    huha
  })
}

# Combine all matched UniProt annotation rows
UP_Matched <- rbindlist(UP_L, use.names = T)
UP_Matched$Score_ref <- Sc

# Convert category strings into a cleaner label set
UP_Matched <- Converge_UP_Categories(UP_Matched)

# Keep rare categories only if they are sufficiently frequent
hu <- table(UP_Matched$UniProt_Category_Clean) / length(UP_Matched$UniProt_Category_Clean)
UP_Matched[!is.na(match(UniProt_Category_Clean, names(hu)[hu < 0.05])), UniProt_Category_Clean := "Other"]

# Pie chart of the final category distribution
PieControl <- make_pie_plot(
  UP_Matched[Use == T & Score_ref > 0.8, dim(.SD)[1], UniProt_Category_Clean],
  "V1",
  "UniProt_Category_Clean",
  start_angle = 17
)

# Store the category annotations back into the main result table
FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$Categories_Uniprot <- "UNKNOWN"
FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$Categories_Uniprot <- UP_Matched$UniProt_Category
FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$UniProt_Category_Clean <- UP_Matched$UniProt_Category_Clean

Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$Uniprot_Isoform_Category <- "UNKNOWN"
Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$UniProt_Category_Clean <- "UNKNOWN"
Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[Use == TRUE & type == "fw"]$Uniprot_Isoform_Category <- UP_Matched$UniProt_Category
Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[Use == TRUE & type == "fw"]$UniProt_Category_Clean <- UP_Matched$UniProt_Category_Clean

# Quick summary plot for the filtered table
make_pie_plot(
  (Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[type == "fw" & Use == T][, dim(.SD)[1], UniProt_Category_Clean]),
  "V1",
  "UniProt_Category_Clean"
)

# Flag intronless genes in the matched table
UP_Matched[, IntronLess := !is.na(match(ENSG, intronlessGenes))]

plotCollecter$pies_UniprotCategories_rebuttal <- PieControl
save(Results_CombinedGels, file = "Results_CombinedGels.rda")
```

## GFF Relative entries

This section compares the UniProt category distribution in the IsoFrac-selected assignments against the full curated UniProt/GFF reference set. It collapses category labels, counts unique sequences per category, and plots absolute and relative category fractions side by side.

```{r}
# Use the curated sequence annotation table as the reference set

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Re-apply category collapsing to the matched IsoFrac assignments

UP_Matched$CleanCategory <- UP_Matched$UniProt_Category_Clean

# Count unique IsoFrac-selected sequences per collapsed category
DT <- UP_Matched[, {
  length(unique(SEQUENCE))
}, CleanCategory]

DT$category_renamed <- DT$CleanCategory

# Derive the same collapsed category labels for the full UniProt/GFF reference
gff$category_renamed <- Converge_UP_Categories_v2(gff$UniProt_Category)

# Remove peptide-only entries from the reference set
gff <- gff[category_renamed != "Peptide"]


# Count unique reference sequences per category
DT_gff <- gff[, length(unique(SEQUENCE)), category_renamed]

# Pie chart of the UniProt reference category distribution
make_pie_plot(DT_gff, "V1", "category_renamed", start_angle = 5) +
  ggtitle("UNIPROT Database Categories")

# Label the two sources for comparison
DT_gff$Type <- "UNIPROT"
DT$Type <- "IsoFrac Best Match"

)

# Side-by-side comparison of absolute counts and relative fractions

          legend.position = "bottom") +

)
```

## DeltaMass Enrichment Heatmap


This section bins isoform candidates by DeltaMass, then tests which GOslim categories are enriched in each bin. The result is a heatmap that links mass shifts to biological process or cellular component terms.

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(biomaRt)

ScoreCutoff <- 0.8

# Use the rounded Uniprot MW as the reference mass for binning
MW <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$Uniprot_MW_round
Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$Uniprot_MW <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$Uniprot_MW_round

# For multi-mappers, use the smallest available MW entry
MW <- sapply(strsplit(MW, ";"), function(x) {
  min(as.numeric(x))
})

# Define gene subsets for the enrichment analysis
liFun <- list(
  Less50kD = MW < 50000,
  More50kD = MW >= 50000,
  Higher100kD = MW > 100000,
  From50To100kD = MW > 50000 & MW < 100000,
  all = MW > -1000
)


for (i in length(liFun)) {
  name_i <- names(liFun)[i]
  table(liFun[i])

  # Keep only high-confidence pairs and the chosen MW subset
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered[
    score_ref > ScoreCutoff & liFun[[i]]
  ]

  # DeltaMass fields used for the enrichment bins
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$DM_min <- as.numeric(FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ScFiltered_DM_min)
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$DeltaMass <- as.numeric(FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$ScFiltered_DM_min)
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$DeltaMass <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$DM_min
  FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$sel <- T

  qfun <- FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels$DM_min
  cutoffDa <- 40
  multiplier <- 1:3
  alphaset <- 0.01

  # Define DeltaMass bin edges
  qs <- c(
    min(qfun, na.rm = T),
    -100000, -50000, -20000, 20000, 50000, 100000,
    max(qfun, na.rm = T)
  )
  qs <- sort(qs)

  # Visualize the DeltaMass distribution with bin boundaries
  df <- data.table(d = unlist(qfun))
  g <- ggplot(df, aes(x = d)) +
    geom_density() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = qs, lty = "dotted") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-max(qfun, na.rm = T), max(qfun, na.rm = T)))

  # Create gene groups for each DeltaMass bin
  PGgroups <- lapply(1:length(qs), function(it) {
    if (it == 1) {
      qfun < qs[it + 1]
    } else if (it == length(qs)) {
      qfun > qs[it]
    } else {
      qfun >= qs[it] & qfun <= qs[it + 1]
    }
  })
  PGgroups <- PGgroups[-length(PGgroups)]

  ENSGgroups <- lapply(PGgroups, function(x) {
    FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[x & sel]$ENSG
  })
  ProteinGroups <- lapply(PGgroups, function(x) {
    FinalSelectedTable_rf_allgels[x & sel]$Uniprot
  })

  # Expand ENSG IDs from semicolon-delimited strings
  ENSGsplit <- unique(unlist(strsplit(unlist(ENSGgroups), ";")))

  # Load cached GO annotation tables or query BioMart if needed
  if (!file.exists("exons.rda")) {
    mart.hs <- useMart("ensembl", "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

    exons <- getBM(
      attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "goslim_goa_accession", "goslim_goa_description"),
      filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
      values = ENSGsplit,
      mart = mart.hs
    )

    exons_go <- getBM(
      attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "name_1006", "go_linkage_type", "definition_1006", "namespace_1003", "go_id"),
      filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
      values = ENSGsplit,
      mart = mart.hs
    )

    exons$NameSpace <- exons_go$namespace_1003[match(exons$goslim_goa_accession, exons_go$go_id)]
    exons$NameSpace[is.na(exons$NameSpace)] <- "UNKNOWN"
    save(exons, exons_go, file = "exons.rda")
  } else {
    load("exons.rda")

    # Optional refresh path for missing annotations
    AllENSG <- unique(unlist(strsplit(unlist(ENSGgroups), ";")))
    missing <- setdiff(AllENSG, exons$ensembl_gene_id)
    if (length(missing) > 0 & 0) {
      library(biomaRt)
      mart.hs <- useMart("ensembl", "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

      li <- listAttributes(mart.hs)
      li[62:63, ]
      grep("HGNC", li$description)
      print(paste(length(missing), "EnsG not annotated. PLease rerun exons functions"))

      biomaRt::biomartCacheClear()

      exons2 <- getBM(
        attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "goslim_goa_accession", "goslim_goa_description", "namespace_1003"),
        filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
        values = missing,
        mart = mart.hs
      )

      hgnc <- getBM(
        attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
        filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
        values = unique(missing),
        mart = mart.hs
      )

      humpe <- 1:length(unique(hgnc$hgnc_symbol))
      humpe <- cut(humpe, round(length(humpe) / 50))

      hgnclist <- lapply(unique(humpe), function(x) {
        print(x)
        temphgnc <- unique(hgnc$hgnc_symbol)[humpe == x]
        getBM(
          attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "goslim_goa_accession", "goslim_goa_description", "namespace_1003", "hgnc_symbol"),
          filters = "hgnc_symbol",
          values = temphgnc,
          mart = mart.hs
        )
      })
      hgnc <- rbindlist(hgnclist)
      setdiff(missing, hgnc$ensembl_gene_id)

      hgnclist_go <- lapply(unique(humpe), function(x) {
        print(x)
        temphgnc <- unique(hgnc$hgnc_symbol)[humpe == x]
        exons2_go <- getBM(
          attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "name_1006", "go_linkage_type", "definition_1006", "namespace_1003", "go_id"),
          filters = "hgnc_symbol",
          values = temphgnc,
          mart = mart.hs
        )
      })

      exons2_go <- rbindlist(hgnclist_go)
      exons2$NameSpace <- exons2_go$namespace_1003[match(exons2$goslim_goa_accession, exons2_go$go_id)]
      exons2$NameSpace[is.na(exons2$NameSpace)] <- "UNKNOWN"

      exons3 <- rbind(as.data.table(exons), as.data.table(exons2), fill = T)
      exons3_go <- rbind(as.data.table(exons2_go), as.data.table(exons_go), fill = T)
      exons3$namespace_1003 <- NULL
      exons <- unique(exons3)
      exons_go <- unique(exons3_go)
      save(exons, exons_go, file = "exons.rda")
    }
  }

  # Start a PDF per MW subset
  graphics.off()
  pdf(pdfname <- paste("Enrichment_Heatmap_DeltaMass_", name_i, ".pdf", sep = ""), height = 5)

  DataCollect <- c()
  DataCollect_MR <- c()
  namespaceList <- list()
  itNL <- 0

  # Enrichment is run for cellular_component here
  for (namespace in "cellular_component") {
    ER <- NULL
    ER_MR <- NULL

    try({
      itNL <- itNL + 1

      # Hypergeometric enrichment across DeltaMass bins
      ER <- EnrichmentWrapper(ENSGgroups, exons, namespace)

      # Combine density plot and heatmap into one figure
      Density_Enrichment <- grid.arrange(
        grobs = list(
          EnhanceDensityplot(g, qs) +
            ggtitle(NULL) +
            theme(
              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
              axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
              axis.text.y = element_blank()
            ) +
            coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-150000, 150000)) +
            xlab("DeltaMass: IsoFrac MW - Uniprot MW"),
          ER$HM[[4]]
        ),
        layout_matrix = matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 2), ncol = 2, nrow = 2),
        widths = c(1, 0.5),
        heights = c(0.4, 1)
      )

      namespaceList[[itNL]] <- list(DM = Density_Enrichment)
      DataCollect <- rbind(DataCollect, ER$DT)
      DataCollect_MR <- rbind(DataCollect_MR, ER_MR$DT)
    })
  }

  # Save the final plot and export the annotation table
  try({
    Density_Enrichment <- grid.arrange(
      grobs = list(
        EnhanceDensityplot(g, qs) +
          coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-150000, 150000)) +
          xlab("DeltaMass: IsoFrac MW - Uniprot MW"),
        ER$HM[[4]]
      ),
      layout_matrix = matrix(1:2, ncol = 1, nrow = 2),
      heights = c(0.7, 1)
    )

    names(namespaceList) <- unique(exons$NameSpace)[1]
    dev.off()

    plotCollecter$Density_Enrichment <- namespaceList
    system(paste("open", pdfname))

    cytoskeleton <- DataCollect[
      goslim_goa_description == "cytoskeleton" &
        NameSpace == "cellular_component" &
        bin == 1
    ]

    unique(cytoskeleton$ensembl_gene_id)

    fwrite(
      DataCollect,
      paste("Isofrac_DeltaMass_EnrichmentAnalysis_", name_i, ".txt", sep = ""),
      sep = "\t"
    )
    system("open ./")
  })
}
```

## Compiling SQLITE Database

This chunk packages the combined IsoFrac results into a single SQLite database, adds per-gel source tables, and stores summary tables that are used later for plotting and manuscript reporting.

```{r}
# Create / open the combined SQLite database
setwd(pa)

library(RSQLite)

dbpath <- "./TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks.sqlite"
db <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbpath)

# Store the current package / pipeline version
dbWriteTable(db, name = "Version", value = Version, overwrite = T)

# Build a gene annotation table across all gels
GN <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
  gel <- x$xname
  dt_gn <- x$dt_gn
  dt_gn$gel <- gel
  dt_gn
})
GN <- rbindlist(GN)

# Combine hdbscan tables across gels and ensure abundance is numeric
hdbscanTables <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
  xtemp <- x$hdbscanTables
  xtemp$Abu <- as.numeric(xtemp$Abu)
  xtemp
})
hdbscanTables <- rbindlist(hdbscanTables)

# Collect per-gel normalized TMT tables
TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
  xtemp <- x$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore
  xtemp
})

# Combine peak result tables and add gel identity
IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
  xtemp <- x$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable
  xtemp$gel <- x$xname
  xtemp
})
IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- rbindlist(IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable)

# Combine identified peak tables and add gel identity
IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
  xtemp <- x$IdentifiedPeaks_Table
  xtemp$gel <- x$xname
  xtemp
})
IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- rbindlist(IdentifiedPeaks_Table)

# Flatten list-columns before writing to SQLite
IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- apply(IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable, 2, unlist)
IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- as.data.table(IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable, integer64 = "double")

IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- apply(IdentifiedPeaks_Table, 2, unlist)
IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- as.data.table(IdentifiedPeaks_Table, integer64 = "double")

# Gel names for metadata
gelnames <- sapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) { x$xname })

# Write core annotation / metadata tables
dbWriteTable(db, "GN", GN, overwrite = T)
dbWriteTable(db, "Gels", data.frame(gels = gelnames), GN, overwrite = T)

# Write combined analysis tables
dbWriteTable(db, "hdbscanTables", hdbscanTables, overwrite = T)

cp <- Results_CombinedGels$Compressed_Pairs
cp_u <- DF_unlist(cp)
dbWriteTable(db, "Compressed_Pairs", cp_u, overwrite = T)

dbWriteTable(db, "IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable", IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable, overwrite = T)
dbWriteTable(db, "IdentifiedPeaks_Table", IdentifiedPeaks_Table, overwrite = T)

# Write per-gel source tables into the database
for (x in TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks) {
  temp <- x$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore

  dbWriteTable(db, paste("TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore", x$xname, sep = "_#_"), temp, overwrite = T)
  dbWriteTable(db, paste("Protein_MW", x$xname, sep = "_#_"), x$Protein_MW, overwrite = T)
  dbWriteTable(db, paste("Fractions_MW", x$xname, sep = "_#_"), data.frame(x$Fractions_predicted_MW), overwrite = T)
  dbWriteTable(db, paste("hdbscanTables", x$xname, sep = "_#_"), data.frame(x$hdbscanTables), overwrite = T)
}

dbListTables(db)

# Write the filtered and unfiltered combined-gel result tables
df <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered
dful <- apply(df, 2, unlist)
dful <- as.data.frame(dful)
colnames(dful) <- make.unique(colnames(dful))

dbWriteTable(db, "CombinedGels_Pairs_Unfiltered", dful, overwrite = T)

dbWriteTable(
  db,
  "CombinedGels_Compressed_Pairs",
  as.data.table(apply(Results_CombinedGels$Compressed_Pairs, 2, unlist), integer64 = "double"),
  overwrite = T
)

colnames(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered) <- make.unique(colnames(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered))
dbWriteTable(db, "CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered", Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered, overwrite = T)
apply(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered, 2, class)

# Build isoform counts per experiment for manuscript summaries
IsoformCount <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
  IP <- x$IdentifiedPeaks_Table

  # Keep only confident identifications and clean peak shapes
  IP <- IP[FDR_RF < 0.01, , ]
  IP <- IP[unlist(Height) >= 0, , ]
  IP <- IP[unlist(Fraction_width) < 2, ]

  # Summarize one row per gene
  IP <- IP[grep(";", ENS, invert = T), {
    list(
      MWlog10 = (unique(MW_lm_Compressed_)),
      mpw = min(unlist(Height)),
      maxFracWidth = max(unlist(Fraction_width), na.rm = T),
      MW_lm_lo = median(MW_lm_lo),
      MW_lm_hi = median(MW_lm_lo)
    )
  }, ENS]

  IP$Experiment <- x$xname
  IP
})

IsoformCountTable <- rbindlist(IsoformCount)

# Standardize experiment labels
table(IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("/peptides.txt", "", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("/peptides_TryChymCOMBINED.txt", "_ChyTry", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("/peptides.txt", "", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("/peptides_TryChymCOMBINED.txt", "_ChyTry", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("2020_12_23_TMTpro_", "gel1_", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
table(IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("2021_10_09_TM.*.pro_", "gel2_", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)

dbWriteTable(db, "IsoformCountTable", IsoformCountTable, overwrite = T)

# Close database and return to the parent directory
dbDisconnect(db)
system("open ./")

file.copy(
  "../Results_CombinedGels.rda",
  paste(dirname(dbpath), "Results_CombinedGels.rda", sep = "/"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

setwd("../")

```


## ReportedTable

This section builds the final reported isoform table by joining the filtered assignments with UniProt annotations, then saves the manuscript-ready TSV and the score-versus-delta-mass plot.

```{r}
# Load supporting objects if they are not already in memory
if (!exists("plotCollecter")) {
  load("plotCollecter.rda")
  load("Results_CombinedGels.rda")
  load("Results_CombinedGels_PacBIO.rda")
  load("Results_CombinedGels_PBUP.rda")
}

# Required by some downstream plotting code
scales_add_defaults <- function() {}

# Match filtered isoform assignments back to the corresponding protein annotations
M1 <- match(
  gsub(" # .*$", "", Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered_DM$Uniprot),
  ProteinSequencesCategories$ProteinID
)

ProteinSequencesCategoriesMatchSubset <- ProteinSequencesCategories[
  M1,
  .SD,
  .SDcols = colnames(ProteinSequencesCategories)
]

# Merge reported isoform calls with the matched UniProt annotation subset
ReportedTable <- cbind(
  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered,
  ProteinSequencesCategoriesMatchSubset
)

# Keep only protein-level identifications
ReportedTable <- ReportedTable[type == "fw"]

# Remove the type column for the final export table
ReportedTable$type <- NULL

# Store the score-versus-delta-mass summary plot for the manuscript figures
plotCollecter$DeltaMass_Scores <- ggplot(
  ReportedTable,
  aes(log10(DM_min), as.numeric(score_ref))
) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 400) +
  xlab("Isofrac MW / Uniprot MW [log10]") +
  ylab("Assignment Score")

# Write the final manuscript table
fwrite(ReportedTable, "Isofrac_Final_Isoform_Table.txt", sep = "\t")
```

## Combined Figure 3 Setup

This chunk prepares all shared plot objects and helper functions used in the final composite figure. It loads the viewer image, category and enrichment plots, formatting for the barplot, and the LDLR trace plotting function so the final figure can be assembled from precomputed panels.

```{r figure_setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load shared figure components
IsViewer <- ggdraw() + draw_image("../IsoFrac_20230217_SimilaritiesTesting_2/IsoFracViewer_v8.png")
Fractions <- plotCollecter$pies_UniprotCategories_rebuttal
GoTerms <- plotCollecter$Density_Enrichment[[1]]$DM
FractionsBar <- plotCollecter$Barplot_UniprotCategories_new_v1

# Clean up the fraction barplot styling
if (length(FractionsBar) == 0) {
  FractionsBar <- ggplot()
}
FractionsBar <- FractionsBar +
  theme(
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),
    text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20)
  )

# Load LDLR annotation and trace plot helper only once
if (!exists("LDLRgg")) {
  library(ggh4x)
  library(ggmap)

  load("AdditionalData/LDRPlot.rda")
  load("WB_Confirmation/WB/LDLR_gg_v2.rda")

  Traces_GGplot <- function(sqpath, PeaksTable = NULL, gel = "10er", ens = "ENSG00000120802",
                            mpwcutoff = 0, converttoMW = TRUE, MassShift = 0,
                            PurePlot = TRUE, showlegend = FALSE, ClusterGroups = NULL) {
    sqf <- dbConnect(SQLite(), sqpath)
    on.exit(dbDisconnect(sqf), add = TRUE)

    FinalPairs <- dbReadTable(sqf, "CombinedGels_Compressed_Pairs")
    fp <- FinalPairs[FinalPairs$ENS == ens, ]

    GelNames <- grep(gel, dbListTables(sqf), value = TRUE)
    input <- list(
      hdbscanTables = dbReadTable(sqf, grep("hdbscan", GelNames, value = TRUE)),
      TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore = dbReadTable(sqf, grep("zscore", GelNames, value = TRUE)),
      MW = dbReadTable(sqf, grep("Fractions_MW", GelNames, value = TRUE))
    )

    hdb <- data.table(input$hdbscanTables)[EnsG == ens]
    tempValues <- input$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore[hdb$id, ]
    tempValues$cl <- hdb$cl_2
    tempValues$id <- hdb$id

    if (any(grepl("^V[0-9]", colnames(tempValues)[1]))) {
      me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = paste0("V", 1:28), id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
      me$variable <- as.numeric(gsub("V", "", me$variable))
    } else {
      me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = 2:29, id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
    }

    # Convert fraction index to molecular weight scale
    if (converttoMW) {
      md <- loess(unlist(input$MW$x.Fractions_predicted_MW) ~ unlist(1:nrow(input$MW)), span = 0.1)
      mds <- 10^predict(md, 2:29)
      me$variable <- (mds[match(me$variable, 2:29)] + MassShift) / 1000
    }

    # Optional remapping to peak MW axis
    if (length(PeaksTable) > 0) {
      lo <- loess(PeaksTable$Peak ~ PeaksTable$MW)
      me$variable <- predict(lo, 10^as.numeric(fp$MW_lm) / 1000)
    }

    # Optional cluster filtering
    if (length(ClusterGroups) > 0) {
      me <- me[!is.na(match(me$cl, ClusterGroups)), ]
    }

    g2 <- ggplot(me[me$cl != 0, ], aes(as.numeric(variable), value, group = id, color = as.character(cl))) +
      geom_line(color = "black") +
      xlab("MW") +
      ylab("zscore") +
      ggtitle(ens)

    list(p = g2, data = me, clusterColors = NA)
  }

  LDLRgg$Traces <- Traces_GGplot(
    "IsoFrac_0.86/TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks.sqlite",
    ens = "ENSG00000130164",
    gel = "5per",
    PurePlot = TRUE,
    ClusterGroups = c(1, 2)
  )$p +
    xlim(c(80, 180)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(105, 138), lty = "dotted", color = "red") +
    annotate("text", y = c(2.3, 5), x = c(105, 138), label = paste(c(105, 138), "kD"), hjust = c(0.5, 0))
}

# Shared trace example panel
G_PEAK <- function(xvec, mu = 20, sd = 2) {
  yvec <- sapply(xvec, function(x) {
    1 / sd * (2 * 3.14)^0.5 * exp(1)^(-0.5 * ((x - mu) / sd)^2)
  })
  list(x = c(NA, xvec), y = c(NA, yvec))
}

it <<- 0
PeakWidth <- 1:28

P1 <- lapply(c(0.8, 0.2), function(x) {
  it <<- it + 1
  x <- round(max(PeakWidth) * x)
  g <- G_PEAK(PeakWidth, mu = x)
  if (it == 1) {
    g$y <- g$y * 0.4
  }
  g
})
P1 <- rbindlist(P1)
P1 <- P1[, .(y = max(y)), x]

P2 <- G_PEAK(PeakWidth, round(0.5 * max(PeakWidth)), sd = 1.5)
P2$y <- P2$y * 0.4

P3 <- G_PEAK(PeakWidth, round(0.8 * max(PeakWidth)), sd = 2)
P3$y <- P3$y * 0.6

it <<- 0
L <- lapply(list(P1, P2, P3), function(x) {
  it <<- it + 1
  hu <- sample(seq(0.5, 1, by = 0.02), 3)
  it2 <<- 0
  hum <- lapply(hu, function(y) {
    it2 <<- it2 + 1
    x$y <- x$y * y
    x$Type <- as.character(it)
    x$linetype <- paste(x$Type, it2, sep = ";")
    x
  })
  x$Type <- it
  rbindlist(hum)
})
L <- rbindlist(L)
L[, hu := as.numeric(y != median(y)), .(Type, x)]
L$hu[is.na(L$hu)] <- 0

isoformTable <- data.frame(
  xmin = c(3, 11, 19),
  xmax = c(9, 17, 25),
  ymin = c(-0.01, -0.01, -0.01),
  ymax = c(1.25, 0.7, 0.95)
)

TraceExamples <- list(
  ggplot(L, aes(x, y, group = linetype)) + geom_line() + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ggplot(L, aes(x, y, group = linetype, color = Type)) + geom_line() + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ggplot(L, aes(x, y, group = linetype, color = Type, lty = as.character(L$hu))) + geom_line() + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ggplot(L, aes(x, y, group = linetype, color = Type, lty = as.character(L$hu))) +
    geom_line() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = isoformTable$xmin[1], xmax = isoformTable$xmax[1], ymin = isoformTable$ymin[1], ymax = isoformTable$ymax[1], color = "black", fill = "transparent", lty = "dotted") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = isoformTable$xmin[2], xmax = isoformTable$xmax[2], ymin = isoformTable$ymin[2], ymax = isoformTable$ymax[2], color = "black", fill = "transparent", lty = "dotted") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = isoformTable$xmin[3], xmax = isoformTable$xmax[3], ymin = isoformTable$ymin[3], ymax = isoformTable$ymax[3], color = "black", fill = "transparent", lty = "dotted") +
    annotate("text", x = mean(unlist(isoformTable[1, 1:2])), y = isoformTable$ymax[1] - 0.07, label = "Iso1", size = 1.5) +
    annotate("text", x = mean(unlist(isoformTable[2, 1:2])), y = isoformTable$ymax[2] - 0.07, label = "Iso2", size = 1.5) +
    annotate("text", x = mean(unlist(isoformTable[3, 1:2])), y = isoformTable$ymax[3] - 0.07, label = "Iso3", size = 1.5) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
)

TraceExamples <- lapply(TraceExamples, function(x) {
  x + ylab("zscore") + xlab("Fractions")
})

TraceExamples_grid <- plot_grid(
  TraceExamples[[1]],
  TraceExamples[[2]],
  TraceExamples[[3]],
  TraceExamples[[4]],
  labels = c("", "i", "ii", "iii"),
  scale = 0.9,
  label_size = 12
)

# Figure labels / counts
allIsoformas <- plotCollecter$TotalNumberOfIsoforms
Genes <- plotCollecter$TotalNumberOfGenes

```


## Combined Figure 3 Plot

This chunk builds the final composite figure by combining the trace examples, isoform count summary, ROC curves, delta-mass density, category composition, GO-term enrichment, and LDLR panels into one multi-panel figure. It then exports the figure as both PDF and JPEG.

```{r figure_plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Top row: trace examples, isoform count summary, ROC curves, and delta-mass density
f3p1 <- plot_grid(
  TraceExamples_grid,
  plotCollecter$gg_IsoformsPerGene +
    ylim(0, 5500) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 5, y = 5000,
                      label = paste("Isoform Evidences: ", allIsoformas, "; Genes: ", Genes),
                      sep = ""),
  plotCollecter$ROC_Curves_combined[[1]],
  plotCollecter$DeltaZoomDensitiesPure +
    xlab("Delta Mass (Isofrac-Uniprot) [Da]") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-150000, 150000)) +
    ggtitle(NULL),
  labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
  ncol = 2,
  scale = c(0.9, 0.95, 0.95, 0.95)
)

# Bottom left: category composition and GO-term enrichment
Fractions <- plotCollecter$pies_UniprotCategories_rebuttal
GoTerms <- plotCollecter$Density_Enrichment[[1]]$DM

# Bottom right: category barplot + LDLR trace panel + viewer
LDLRcombi <- plot_grid(
  LDLRgg$Traces +
    xlab("MW [kD]") +
    ylab("zscore") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ggtitle("LDLR"),
  LDLR_gg$ggOri +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    ggtitle("LDLR"),
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.9)
)

f3_lowerPanel <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(
    Fractions,
    GoTerms,
    ncol = 1,
    labels = c("E", "G"),
    rel_heights = c(0.6, 1),
    scale = c(1, 0.95)
  ),
  plot_grid(
    FractionsBar + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.75)),
    LDLRcombi,
    IsViewer,
    ncol = 1,
    labels = c("F", "H", "I"),
    rel_heights = c(0.8, 0.7, 0.6),
    scale = c(1, 0.9, 0.9)
  ),
  ncol = 2
)

gg3 <- plot_grid(
  f3p1,
  f3_lowerPanel,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.7, 0.95)
)

pdf("Figure_3_v3.pdf", height = 12, width = 10)
plot(gg3)
dev.off()
ggsave("Figure_3_v3.jpeg", gg3, width = 10, height = 12)
```
